recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13976 unless a future work group decision revisits the Procedure.focalDevice model or wording beyond this STU3 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-13976 was a Published FHIR-core Procedure change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for STU3, asking that Procedure.focalDevice's confusing short description "Device changed in procedure" be updated to "Manipulated, implanted, or removed device" while retaining the longer definition about implanted, removed, or otherwise manipulated devices.
initial_application: Historical commit 52ac1cc0e7288f26eca9df7e2fb559dcbcbc1efd changed the Procedure spreadsheet short name from "Device changed in procedure" to "Manipulated, implanted, or removed device" in a 2017 batched Procedure/clinical resources update. Later source conversion preserved that wording in source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml.
additional_context: Procedure is an active current-build resource through source/fhir.ini. The old short description now appears only in frozen tools/history release2 and release3 snapshots, while current active Procedure source and later frozen history contain the resolved wording. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-13976 and Procedure.focalDevice found no relevant later discussion or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml already has <short value="Manipulated, implanted, or removed device"/> on Procedure.focalDevice and the remaining old wording is outside active current-build source.
